CustomField.description: CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date.
CustomField.formula: DATE( YEAR( IM_Booked_Date__c ) + FLOOR( ( MONTH ( IM_Booked_Date__c ) + VALUE(TEXT( Grace_Period__c )) - 1 ) / 12 ), MOD( MONTH ( IM_Booked_Date__c ) + VALUE(TEXT( Grace_Period__c )) - 1 + IF( DAY ( IM_Booked_Date__c ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( IM_Booked_Date__c ) + VALUE(TEXT( Grace_Period__c )) - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, 0 ), 12 ) + 1, IF( DAY( IM_Booked_Date__c ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( IM_Booked_Date__c ) + VALUE(TEXT( Grace_Period__c )) - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, DAY( IM_Booked_Date__c ) ) )
CustomField.label: Storage Minimum Effective Date
